name: PhaseBanner
description: a banner showing service development phase and inviting feedback
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: Native semantics — no special ARIA needed
Consumers may add `role="region"` + `aria-label` if they treat this banner as a landmark
keyboard: Native anchor keyboard behaviour applies for any feedback link inside the banner
props: `children`: slot (required) (default: —) — Descriptive text and feedback link
`...restProps`: HTML attributes (default: —) — Spread onto the root `<div>`
